news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Peer-reviewed data from the 16-week induction period of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study were published in The Lancet, providing independent validation of rezpegaldesleukin's efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamics and biomarker findings in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The publication reinforces the scientific credibility behind the drug as it advances through the ongoing Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: JPMorgan Reinstates Coverage of Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating
news.summary: JPMorgan resumed research coverage of Nektar with a Neutral rating following the company's large capital raises and Q2 report, reflecting a more cautious sell-side stance even as other analysts stayed bullish. The move added to a mixed but broadly constructive wave of analyst commentary after the ZENITH AD Phase 3 launch and Q2 earnings.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Reaffirms Buy Rating on Nektar Therapeutics, Price Target Raised to $192
news.source: Piper Sandler (via The Globe and Mail / Futu)
news.summary: Piper Sandler reiterated its Buy rating and raised its price target on NKTR, citing the strengthened cash position, the ongoing ZENITH AD Phase 3 enrollment and continued confidence in rezpegaldesleukin's commercial potential across atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata. The bullish note stood in contrast to more cautious commentary from other desks the same week.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.1 million and a net loss of $40.6 million ($1.23/share), while cash and investments rose to $1,023.4 million as of June 30, 2026 (from $245.8 million at year-end 2025) after equity raises, with year-end cash guided to $815-840 million and runway extended into Q3 2028. R&D spend rose about 31% to $39.1 million as the company ramps up Phase 3 manufacturing and trial costs for rezpegaldesleukin, and management reiterated a mid-2028 Phase 3 AD readout and 2029 BLA target.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides as Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Shares fell in the days after Q2 earnings as investors weighed the roughly $40 million quarterly net loss and negative free cash flow against modest ~$10 million quarterly revenue, even though the newly bolstered $1 billion-plus cash balance funds operations into Q3 2028. The piece framed the core investor tension going forward: continued heavy cash burn during Phase 3 versus the size of the atopic dermatitis/alopecia areata opportunity if rezpegaldesleukin succeeds.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, each targeting roughly 510 patients. This marks the transition of Nektar's lead asset into pivotal-stage development, with a third trial (ZENITH AD-3) for treatment-experienced patients slated to start in September 2026, topline data expected mid-2028, and a BLA targeted for 2029.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial begins (N.D. Cal., San Francisco)
catalysts.detail: The breach-of-contract trial over the pair's terminated rezpegaldesleukin collaboration is set to open before an 8-person jury under Judge James Donato, after a pretrial conference was held in August. Nektar alleges Lilly's flawed trial statistics and mismanagement of the ISLAND lupus study understated rezpeg's efficacy and cost it milestone and royalty payments; Lilly denies wrongdoing. As of September 6 the date has not been postponed again, making this a binary, clinically-uncorrelated catalyst arriving in two days.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: The third of three registrational Phase 3 trials in the ZENITH AD program, enrolling biologic/JAK-inhibitor treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients, is expected to begin dosing in September 2026, completing the full Phase 3 AD trial start-up.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar is expected to report third-quarter 2026 financial results and provide updated cash runway and Phase 3 enrollment progress, typically in mid-November based on prior quarterly cadence. It should also address any financial or strategic fallout from the September 8 Eli Lilly trial verdict.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata registrational trial start
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment on trial design (built on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA 52-week data), Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata in early 2027.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline efficacy and safety data from the first two pivotal ZENITH AD trials in treatment-naive atopic dermatitis patients are expected around mid-2028, the key value-inflection readout for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the third ZENITH AD trial, enrolling treatment-experienced patients, is expected to follow the first two trials, rounding out the full AD Phase 3 dataset ahead of a planned BLA filing.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to a first Biologics License Application submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029, contingent on positive Phase 3 ZENITH AD results.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata 52-week topline data
catalysts.detail: The registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study is expected to read out 52-week topline efficacy data around mid-2028, following the same general timeline cadence as the AD program.

catalysts.label: Cash runway endpoint
catalysts.detail: Following its 2026 capital raises, Nektar has guided current cash and investments to fund operations into Q3 2028, covering the AD Phase 3 readout; any incremental financing need before or after this point is a catalyst/risk to watch.

pulse: NKTR trades near $74 (market cap roughly $2.5 billion) after a volatile year that saw shares swing between a 52-week low of about $25 and a high near $109, with the stock pulling back from summer highs following Q2 2026 earnings that showed a modest ~$10 million revenue base against a ~$40 million quarterly net loss. The most immediate event is the September 8 Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury trial in San Francisco over their terminated rezpeg collaboration, a binary legal catalyst uncorrelated with the clinical story, arriving just after an August Lancet publication of positive Phase 2b atopic dermatitis data and a split analyst reaction (Piper Sandler Buy/$192 vs. JPMorgan Neutral). Watch the Lilly trial's outcome, the ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 start guided for September, progress toward the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start, and cash-burn versus the $1 billion-plus balance sheet heading into Q3 earnings.
